title: Mini Lip Gloss Trio Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Natural Finish
What it is: A mini lip gloss trio with the signature clear shade and two new shimmer shades for high-shine, nonsticky hydration on the go.

What Else You Need to Know: This limited-edition trio features the signature clear gloss alongside two exclusive shimmer shades in a travel-friendly mini size. The lightweight, nonsticky formula hydrates lips while delivering a smooth, high-shine finish that can be worn alone or layered over Lip Sculpt (sold separately).

This Set Contains:
- 3 x 0.17 oz/5 mL Mini Lip Gloss
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Squeeze a small amount of lip gloss and glide over the lips for an elevated, high shine finish. -Wear alone or layer over Lip Sculpt (sold separately).
Ingredients+
Clear Lip Gloss:
Polyisobutene, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Octyldodecanol, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Wax, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Synthetic Beeswax, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phenoxyethanol, Caprylyl Glycol, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Behenate, Sodium Hyaluronate.

Solstice and Gaia:
Polyisobutene, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Cera (Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Wax), Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phenoxyethanol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Caprylyl Glycol, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Behenate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tin Oxide [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891)].
